name: advertising-over-gating
why: Zed thread 7768745e, 2026-11-09: the shift from gating shell reads to advertising and redirecting.
prompt: A thread asked whether refusing shell reads at Gate was the right shape, and what to do instead. From the enforcement measurement, state the cost of a refusal versus a redirect, what a redirected call records, and why the replacement is worth it. Cite each finding as `path:line`.
